tooltip.ramesses_curse.crimson_requiem.w: Left-click creates a cross-shaped sword wave with equivalent melee damage and no cooldown
tooltip.ramesses_curse.crimson_requiem.t: Right-click throws a returning blade, dealing %s true damage and %s magic damage to entities
tooltip.ramesses_curse.crimson_requiem.b: Shift+left-click releases a fireball and wither skull that deal explosion damage. Cooldown: 10s
tooltip.ramesses_curse.crimson_requiem.w: Shift+right-click targets a visible enemy within %s blocks. Rift blades accelerate into the target with small blasts, followed by a spinning execution sword. Cooldown: %ss
tooltip.ramesses_curse.crimson_requiem.l: The gods decreed my limits. I forged them into a blade.
The crimson moon drinks the stars; the dark edge severs fate.
Only when I sheathe this sword may existence resume.
tooltip.ramesses_curse.crimson_requiem.a: True Name of the Blade · Attributes
tooltip.ramesses_curse.crimson_requiem.p: Ignores invulnerability frames and dynamic damage reduction
tooltip.ramesses_curse.crimson_requiem.t: Breaks and drops blocks until its first entity hit; then spares terrain
tooltip.ramesses_curse.crimson_requiem.h: Hold [Shift] · Reveal the blade’s true name
tooltip.ramesses_curse.sword_storm.1: Crimson Requiem only. Throwing summons six orbiting swords.
tooltip.ramesses_curse.sword_storm.2: Each lock within 20 blocks consumes one orbiting sword and sends 1–15 blades inward in succession from all directions. Ends after six volleys.
tooltip.ramesses_curse.sword_storm.3: Each blade deals true and magic damage based on current health and luck at impact, bypassing attack intervals, hurt immunity and dynamic reduction. Soul Pursuit adds homing.
tooltip.ramesses_curse.sword_storm.4: Only kills dealt by the falling swords drop twice the items and experience.
message.ramesses_curse.crimson_requiem.n: Aim at a visible enemy within %s blocks
message.ramesses_curse.crimson_requiem.e: Rift Execution (Shift+right-click) cooldown cleared. An active execution must still finish.
